servers.name: Azure Arc Servers
servers.purpose: Arc-enabled server inventory, details, and extension management

tools.name: arc_list_servers
tools.description: List Arc-enabled servers in the subscription, optionally filtered by resource group, OS type, or status

parameters.osType: Optional OS filter: Windows or Linux
parameters.status: Optional status filter: Connected, Disconnected, Expired, Error
parameters.location: Optional Azure region filter (e.g., eastus, westeurope)
parameters.tags: Optional tag filter as key=value pairs (e.g., environment=production)
parameters.top: Maximum number of servers to return (default: 100)

tools.name: arc_get_server
tools.description: Get full details of a specific Arc-enabled server including agent version, OS profile, network info, and provisioning state

tools.name: arc_list_extensions
tools.description: List all VM extensions installed on an Arc-enabled server with their status and version

tools.name: arc_install_extension
tools.description: Install a VM extension on an Arc-enabled server (e.g., Azure Monitor Agent, Defender, Custom Script)

parameters.settings: Optional JSON settings for the extension

tools.name: arc_remove_extension
tools.description: Remove a VM extension from an Arc-enabled server

servers.name: Azure Arc Operations
servers.purpose: Remote command execution and Azure Update Manager operations for Arc-enabled servers

tools.name: arc_run_command
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell (Windows) or Shell (Linux) script on an Arc-enabled server via Azure Run Command

parameters.script: The script content to execute (PowerShell for Windows, Bash for Linux)

tools.name: arc_get_command_result
tools.description: Get the result of a previously submitted Run Command including stdout, stderr, and exit code

tools.name: arc_assess_updates
tools.description: Trigger an on-demand update assessment for an Arc-enabled server via Azure Update Manager

tools.name: arc_install_updates
tools.description: Trigger on-demand update installation on an Arc-enabled server with classification and reboot options

parameters.classifications: Update classifications to install: Critical, Security, UpdateRollup, FeaturePack, ServicePack, Definition, Tools, Updates
parameters.rebootSetting: Reboot behavior: IfRequired, NeverReboot, AlwaysReboot (default: IfRequired)

tools.name: arc_get_update_history
tools.description: Get update installation history for an Arc-enabled server from Azure Update Manager

servers.name: Azure Arc Governance
servers.purpose: Azure Policy compliance and machine configuration (guest config) for Arc-enabled servers

tools.name: arc_get_policy_compliance
tools.description: Get Azure Policy compliance state for Arc-enabled servers in the subscription or resource group

parameters.policyDefinitionName: Optional specific policy definition to check

tools.name: arc_list_guest_config_assignments
tools.description: List machine configuration (guest config) assignments for an Arc-enabled server

tools.name: arc_get_guest_config_report
tools.description: Get the latest machine configuration compliance report for a specific assignment on an Arc-enabled server
